description_en: Deletes a VPN destination route by calling the DeleteVpnRouteEntry operation
description_zh: 调用DeleteVpnRouteEntry接口删除VPN目的路由
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-vpn-route-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1a3kqjiiq9legfx0000 --route-dest 10.0.0.0/24 --next-hop vco-bp15oes1py4i66rmd0000 --weight 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVpnRouteEntry

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPN gateway instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: VPN网关实例所属地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the destination route
parameters.name: route_dest

parameters.help_en: The next hop of the destination route
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en:
The weight of the destination route. Valid values:

0: low priority.

100: high priority
parameters.help_zh:
目的路由的权重值，取值：

0：低优先级。

100：高优先级
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to Ipsec (IPsec tunneling protocol)
parameters.help_zh: 隧道协议，取值：Ipsec（IPsec隧道协议）
parameters.name: overlay_mode
